description: Plan one Agent Commerce Network (ACN) run without executing it: validate the run shape across Rider, Warrant, Tollkeeper, Quikgater, PCC, AWLpay, PSI, and Conductor, plus any optional stage whose spec field is present. Pure and read-only — no disk, no network, nothing is charged or started. Returns the planned stages, quote, and settlement preview. Use to dry-run a run before spl_agentic_run; use spl_agentic_context to shrink the context a run will carry.

action.description: Run action or stage name, e.g. plan, compress, or a stage key. Determines which stages the plan includes.

agent.description: Agent spec for the run; string id or object.

asyncRun.description: Async run spec for the run.

audit.description: Audit or audit-export input; string id or object.

bytes.description: Input byte count the run will process; used for the quote.

chamberSeal.description: Chamber seal input for the run.

conductorReview.description: Conductor review input for the run.

conductorTask.description: Conductor task spec; string id or object.

crossing.description: Crossing or bridge identifier when the run moves between systems.

cuni.description: CuNi program or exactness input for the run.

demo.description: True to plan or run a demo with no payment and no Rider token.

depotBilling.description: Depot billing input for the run.

depotReceipt.description: Depot receipt input for the run.

depotStore.description: Depot store input for the run.

mcpTool.description: MCP tool call spec for the run.

message.description: Message payload for an agent-messaging stage.

privateBench.description: Private benchmark input for the run.

rail.description: Payment rail: stripe for humans, x402 for agents.

reputation.description: Reputation input for the run; string id or object.

rider.description: Agent-Rider JWT identifying the acting agent. Required for live runs unless demo is true.

riderPaidCall.description: Paid Rider call input for the run.

sandbox.description: Sandbox spec for an isolated step.

sku.description: SKU to buy or price; string id or object.

solana.description: Solana transaction input for the run.

standingRider.description: Standing Rider credential for the run; string id or object.

swap.description: Swap details for a cross-chain step (from/to chain, token, amount).

tokenBudget.description: Token budget for the run; string id or object.

tool.description: Tool call spec for the run.

warrantTemplate.description: Warrant template to apply to the run; string id or object.

name: spl_agentic_plan
